problems.message: name is missing
scope "web" must be "root" or an object with children
no-part: needs "on" (a shape) or "from" and "to" (a line)
both: has "on" and also "from" or "to"; use one or the other
unknown-shape: unknown object "gone"
half-line: "from" and "to" go together
no-connection: web → db is not a connection in the model
unknown-end: unknown object "gone"
bad-affects: affects: unknown object "nope"
bad-rating: severity must be a whole number from 1 to 10
bad-rating: occurrence must be a whole number from 1 to 10
bad-rating: detection must be a whole number from 1 to 10
bad-after: after severity must be a whole number from 1 to 10
bad-status: status "finished" must be open, planned, done or accepted
bad-flow: flow "nope" doesn't exist
step-without-flow: step needs a flow
step-zero: step must be a whole number from 1
step-beyond: step 9 is outside flow "checkout", which has 3 steps
blank-mode: "mode" is missing
Bad-Id: the id must use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not starting with a dash ("root" is reserved)

analyses.markdown:
## Plum fail scenario (ordering)

Analysed 15 of 26
Not analysed: Ordering > Customer app, Ordering > Website, Ordering > Order API > Menu, Ordering > Order API > Basket, Ordering > Order API > Pricing, Ordering > Order API > Order status, Delivery > Courier app, Delivery > Dispatch > Matcher, Notifications > Message templates, Back office > Admin dashboard, Back office > Support console

| Risk band | Part | Mode | Effect | Cause | Severity | Likelihood | Hard to spot | Risk | Controls | Next action | Owner | Status | Severity after | Likelihood after | Hard to spot after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High | Ordering > Order API > Refunds | Stripe refunds the money but the database write fails | The customer has the money back, and Plum still shows the order as paid. | Orders DB is out of reach at the moment the refund is saved. | 9 | 2 | 7 | 126 | Support can see the refund in Stripe. | Compare refunds with Stripe every night. | Support tools | open |  |  |  |
| High | Ordering > Orders DB | Orders DB is unavailable | No order can be placed or read until it is back. | The primary fails, or a failover takes longer than planned. | 10 | 2 | 1 | 20 | A standby takes over within a minute. | Rehearse the failover every quarter. | Platform | planned |  |  |  |
| Medium | Notifier to Twilio | Twilio accepts an SMS and the carrier drops it | The customer never gets the confirmation or the courier's arrival message. | The number is wrong, switched off or blocked by the carrier. | 4 | 4 | 9 | 144 | None. Plum does not read Twilio's delivery receipts. | Read the delivery receipts and alert when fewer than 95% arrive. | Notifications | open |  |  |  |
| Medium | ETA to Mapbox | Mapbox calls fail at dinner rush | Dispatch has no travel times, so couriers are matched on distance alone. | Plum passes Mapbox's rate limit once orders pass 900 a minute. | 6 | 6 | 3 | 108 | Dispatch falls back to straight-line distance. | Batch the travel-time calls, as the second run tries. | Delivery | planned | 6 | 2 | 3 |
| Medium | Delivery > Dispatch > Offers | No courier answers within 30 seconds | The order waits for a courier, and the arrival time shown keeps growing. | The couriers near the restaurant are busy, out of signal or away from their phones. | 6 | 6 | 3 | 108 | Each offer moves on to the next courier. When the list runs out, the customer is told. | Widen the search when the list runs out. | Delivery | planned | 6 | 3 | 3 |
| Medium | Checkout to Stripe | Stripe doesn't answer within five seconds | The order waits on a hold that may or may not exist. | Stripe is slow, or the network between Plum and Stripe drops. | 8 | 4 | 3 | 96 | Three tries with backoff. The idempotency key stops a double hold. | Page when more than 1% of holds time out for five minutes. | Payments | planned | 8 | 4 | 1 |
| Medium | Ordering > Order events | Dispatch reads events slower than they arrive | A courier is matched minutes after the customer paid, and the arrival time shown is wrong. | A burst of orders, such as the dinner rush, outruns the one consumer Dispatch runs. | 5 | 5 | 3 | 75 | A lag alert fires at 30 seconds. | Run a second Dispatch consumer. | Delivery | planned | 5 | 2 | 3 |
| Low | Ordering > Menu cache | Serves a menu five minutes late | A customer orders a dish the kitchen has just taken off. | The cache refreshes every five minutes. | 2 | 8 | 3 | 48 | The kitchen can refuse an item, and the customer is told. |  | Ordering | accepted |  |  |  |
| Low | Checkout to Stripe | Stripe declines the card | The order is not placed, and the customer is asked for another card. | The card is short of funds, expired or blocked. | 3 | 7 | 2 | 42 | The hold is released and the app asks again. |  | Payments | accepted |  |  |  |
| Low | Ordering > Kitchen tablet | The tablet goes offline and nobody accepts within two minutes | The customer waits two minutes and then hears that the order was cancelled. | The tablet loses its Wi-Fi, or its battery runs out. | 4 | 5 | 2 | 40 | The order cancels itself and the card hold is released. |  | Restaurants | accepted |  |  |  |
| Low | Delivery > Live tracking | The courier loses signal and the map freezes | The customer sees a courier who has stopped moving. | The courier drives through a tunnel or a dead zone. | 2 | 7 | 2 | 28 | A position older than a minute is dropped, so the map holds still and does not jump when the signal returns. |  | Delivery | accepted |  |  |  |
| Low | Ordering > Order API | A double tap places two orders | The customer is charged twice for one basket. | The app sends the order again when the first reply is slow. | 6 | 5 | 4 | 24 | Every order carries an idempotency key, and a second order with the same key is refused. |  | Ordering | done | 6 | 1 | 4 |
| Low | Back office > Data warehouse | The warehouse is down | Reports run late. Orders carry on. | The cluster is being upgraded, or its disk is full. | 2 | 3 | 4 | 24 | Events wait on the stream and are replayed when it is back. |  | Data | accepted |  |  |  |
| Not rated | Delivery > Fleet DB | Position writes fail | Live tracking shows an old position, or none. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | Delivery | open |  |  |  |
